title: Ordinary strict tensor reduction and termwise functors
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] with a monoidal structure [def-sfb-monoidal-category], and let $Q:\mathbf N^{op}\to\mathcal A$ be a strict inverse sequence [def-weil-inverse-system]. Define its ordinary strict tensor reduction by $\operatorname{red}_Q(M)_n=M\otimes Q_n$, with transitions $1_M\otimes Q(t)$ and, on a morphism $f$, components $f\otimes1_{Q_n}$: equivalently, $\operatorname{red}_Q=\Delta\mathbin{\circ}(-\otimes Q)$ in diagrammatic composition order. If tensor is additive in each variable, use the resulting additive structure on this functor. For a category $\mathcal B$ and a functor $F:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$, define the termwise functor on strict sequences by postcomposition $T\mapsto T\mathbin{\circ}F$ in diagrammatic order, and $\alpha\mapsto\alpha F$. For abelian $\mathcal B$, when $F$ preserves finite limits, respectively finite colimits, use the pointwise finite-limit, respectively finite-colimit, preservation structures on this termwise functor. These are ordinary constructions, without any derived existence or comparison assertion. The index $n\in\mathbf N$ encodes the positive level $n+1$.
